lines.en: label dormwarssix10:
scene baristawar1
: Haruka. You’re on.
scene baristawar2
: Oh...what? Really? I figured there’d be, like...an actual camera crew or something.
: There is! But you can only see it if you believe. Kind of like Santa Claus.

: I think it’s more like how the world looks more colorful when you’re young because your eyes slowly degrade over time. Or how you stop being able to hear certain sound frequencies as you get older and begin to die.
: I think it’s like Santa Claus.
: Yeah, it’s probably like Santa Claus.
: Can I start now or are you two not finished yet?
: Can you make me a caramel macchiato, Work-Mom? I’m really tired after watching Molly try to be athletic.
: I would have won if the obstacle course was only one phase, Rin!
: Okay, yeah. I’m just going to start.
scene baristawar3
if harukaspring1 == True:
: Welcome to Koi Cafe — a regular, law-abiding coffee shop established in 2018!
else:
: Welcome to Koi Cafe — a local female-owned business started by myself, a female, in the year 2018!
: Why...did you make it sound so suspicious?...
: Don’t mind her, Sana. Haruka just be saying shit sometimes.
: I’m joined here today by two girls who have definitely not been barista-certified, but will be allowed to use my equipment regardless because I think it will make for good publicity!
scene baristawar4
: So please do not break my things! They were all very expensive and I am not done repaying my loans yet.
: If...Molly can use these things without breaking them...I think we should be fine too...
: I want to take exception to this but, frankly, Zagull makes a good point.
: So what do we have to do exactly? Just make drinks and shit?
: Kind of. But the two of you will be serving real-live customers today. So whoever makes it through a shift with the highest customer-satisfaction score wins.
scene baristawar5
: Wait, we have to serve actual people? I suck with customers. That’s why I got fired from Pepper Lunch.
: Well, you can rest easy knowing that being fired today won’t matter at all in the grand scheme of things since this isn’t actually a real job!
: Is there...anything else we should know?
scene baristawar6
: Be more worried. Why am I the only one dreading this?
: I mean...I kind of already do this for work. Just I make people drunk instead of...caffeinated.
: No hidden caveats. Just drinks. Except for one hidden caveat.
scene baristawar7
: But you just said-
: No I didn’t! Anyway, let me give you two a crash course on how to use everything before all the caveats come in.
scene baristawar8
: Wait, now there’s more than one?!
: What do you think the chances are of me being able to order a vanilla bean copyrighted frozen beverage right now?
: Probably low on account of the cafe being closed for a special event. I could use a drink too, though.
: Same. I was up last night having tons of sex with an idol.
scene baristawar9
: Wow. What a completely rude and insensitive thing to say to both of us. Especially after one of us dressed up like a cat and wore a tail-plug for you.
: I’m sorry, what?
: I’m just trying to desensitize you for when you ultimately have to confront her, Maya. It’s going to happen sooner than you think now that she’s no longer clinging to the shadows.
: I miss when I got to cling to the shadows. This ridiculous gigolo arc has been extremely difficult to cope with.
: I really don’t want to just graze over this tail-plug thing.
scene baristawar10
: Honestly, I forgot it was even there until Otoha started yanking on it.
: Otoha? Is this another sex dream thing or am I just missing out on something here?
: Be glad you missed out, Ami. I don’t think you’d have handled that environment very well.
: What do you mean? I’m famously good at handling anything and everything and have never broken down or lost sight of what’s important even once.
: Yup. Sounds like Ami alright.
: Should I buy a tail-plug too? Will it make you love me more?
: Clearly not if he’s still going to have sex with her over you.
if amifingered == False:
: He doesn’t have sex with me at all. That’s why I’m so desperate.
else:
: Fair enough. He does have sex with me sometimes and I’m still desperate too. So I get it.
: Please don’t buy a tail-plug, Ami. I have enough problems I already have to deal with at home.
if kirinchristmalloween1 == True:
scene baristawar11
: Hey, before we start...should we maybe talk about Christmalloween? I think there may have been some sort of...misunderstanding.
: A misunderstanding?...

: Yeah. Like...there was no wrongdoing or anything, right? I was just...distracted and didn’t realize you weren’t exactly feeling it. Like, I obviously would have stopped if I really thought you wanted me to.
: Okay. Guess we’ve talked about it then. Not much more to say.
: You haven’t, like...told anyone, have you? Because it’d be really easy for someone to misinterpret the situation and that would, like...not be good for me.
: Ask your friend that walked in on it. Or her daughter, who could have stepped in but didn’t. I’m not going to tell people something I’m so ashamed of.
: Ashamed? Why? What do you have to be ashamed of? I was the aggressor. And I’m older than you. So if anyone should be ashamed, it’s me for not really...reading the room.
: A bathroom stall isn’t really much of a room, though, is it?
: Well, no...but-
: I’m not going to tell anyone, Haruka. But I’d also appreciate it if you didn’t talk to me anymore. Like...at all.
: So just a...one-time thing then.
: If that’s what you want to call it, sure.
: Okay...guess I’ll just...leave you alone, then.
: Cool. Thanks.
scene baristawar12
: You’re...really sure you’re not going to tell anyone, right?
if sarasex == True:
scene baristawar13
: Uhh...Sara? Is everything okay?
: No, Ayane. Everything is most certainly not okay.
if kirinchristmalloween1 == True:

: My daughter still wants to have a threesome with me, one of my best friends has cancer, and I recently caught a different friend of mine potentially trying to take advantage of a teenage girl in a bathroom.
else:
: My daughter still wants to have a threesome with me, one of my best friends has cancer, and I now have to wait another year for season three of The Pitt to find out what happens to Baby Jane Doe.
: So yeah. It’s all pretty fucking terrible.
: Sana’s still...trying to get you to do that?
scene baristawar14
: I wouldn’t say she’s really trying. It’s more like she’s just made up my mind for me and there’s just nothing I can do to stop her.
: Like, she tried to kiss me the other day. No Sensei. Just the two of us. Alone in the bar. And she wanted to call it “practice” for the “real thing.”
: That...doesn’t really sound like Sana...
scene baristawar15
: That’s what I thought! But if it’s happening all the time now, maybe it is like her?! Like, maybe she’s just taking our genetic horniness up a level and being even weirder about it than I am?!
: Do you...want me to talk to her, maybe? Sana listens to me. And if I can get through to her about this, maybe you guys can-
scene baristawar16
: No, Ayane. I don’t want you to talk to my daughter about her unusual perversions. That’s something I’m supposed to handle, if anyone.
: But at this rate, I’ve more or less just resigned myself to the fact that it’s going to happen regardless of how I feel and that fighting it won’t do anything but push her away.
: Well...maybe pushing her away is what needs to happen if you want to stay true to yourself and be happy with who you are as a person, Sara?
: Having a child means being willing to sacrifice your happiness for their sake. And if this is what Sana really thinks she needs to be happy, I can...suffer for that.

: There needs to be a line, though...right? Like, I understand the point of sacrificing your own happiness for someone you love, but there comes a point where the trade-off is just super imbalanced, don’t you think?
: Maybe “sacrificing your happiness” isn’t how I should have put it. Like...I don’t know. It’s not going to be the end of the world or anything when it happens. It’s just wrong.
: And I know it’s wrong. But so is letting her drink. And so is turning a blind eye to what she does with Sensei. And so is forcing her to work at a bar that I can’t handle on my own.
: So what right do I have to deny her of something she wants that just also happens to be wrong? After I’ve forced so much...incorrectness into her life already?

: I don’t know. I imagine it’s hard to understand when you don’t have a daughter of your own. But I love her so deeply that I would do anything she wants because I’m afraid of a world where she doesn’t love me back.
scene baristawar17
: I get what you mean...
: I’m just...sorry.
: That Sana’s put you into such a...terrible situation.
: She’s only putting me into this situation at all because I fucked up somewhere down the line. Could’ve been anywhere really. It’s happened so many times.

: But if I’d only raised her better...done something different...she wouldn’t be like this. So it’s like I’ve made my bed and now I have to lie in it. Or, in this case, I’ve made my daughter and now I have to lie with her.
: And probably get shown up in the process because she’s tiny and cute and excited at the prospect of exploring a new world while I’m just a few more years away from having back problems.

: I’m sorry for venting like this, Ayane. Just...nobody else knows yet. And you’ve obviously become like another daughter to me. I just hope it doesn’t sound like I’m bitching about your little sister.
: It doesn’t...don’t worry.
: You know...
: I’ve been having this...weird dream lately.
scene baristawar18
: The caveats are here! Bring in the white people and let the contest begin!
: Quick, somebody hide Otoha.
scene baristawar19
: Wha-?!
: SWEEEEEEET CAAAAROLIIIIIINE ~ BUM BUM BUM! GOOD TIIIIMES NEEEVER SEEMED SO GOOD!
: SO GOOD! SO GOOD! SO GOOD!
: What is this strange and seemingly ritualistic song they’re singing?! NO ENGLISH. CAN’T SPEAK. JAPANESE ONLY.
: Hello. Nice to meet you. My name is Sana.
: すごい！英語上手ですね！
scene baristawar20
: That one’s an impostor! He can clearly speak Japanese!
: ありがとうございます。ご注文は？
: I don’t know any other Japanese words.
: I still don’t understand why those were the only ones you chose to learn in the first place.
: IIIII’VE BEEN INCLINED ~ BUM BUM BUM! TO BELIEVE THEY NEVER WOOOOOULD-
scene baristawar21
: Stop your singing and read the sign! Japanese only!
: I think the sign says that English is okay.
scene baristawar22
: Wow! If only I COULD FUCKING READ IT!!!
scene baristawar23
: Are you sure you don’t want me to help them?
: No, it’s fine. Your other teacher was pretty insistent on throwing them a curveball.
: Plus, immersive learning experiences like this will make for good experience once Japan opens back up and they have to regularly communicate with tourists.
if harukasex == True:
: You mean when your husband returns from space to find out that you’ve been getting bent over his side of the bed by another man?
scene baristawar24
: Thank you, Molly. That is something I definitely wanted to be thinking about right now.
: Which hero will you side with, I wonder? The man you already chose? Or the chosen one himself?
: Being the chosen one would certainly explain why Sensei is able to sleep with virtually all of you without ever incurring any consequences, yeah.
: There are consequences aplenty, Magistrate. I can only imagine how difficult it must be for him to sort through thousands of CGs just to find the sex scene he’s trying to recollect.
: Besides! Maybe your husband is one of those weird people who actually likes NTR?
scene baristawar25
: Or maybe he will be unable to cope with the thought of his beloved being claimed by another while he was off protecting our country from aliens? One can do naught but wonder...
: If either of the two girls up there are good at this, I’m hiring one of them to replace you.
scene baristawar26
: Please don’t. This is where I get my gacha money.
else:

: You mean when your husband returns from space that you’ve somehow, almost miraculously, managed to avoid an easily accessible sexual relationship with a very attractive man that has vaginally penetrated basically everyone else you know?
scene baristawar27
: Right. And if he does not have copious amounts of sex with me upon his return, I am probably going to just kill him and then myself because this has been extraordinarily difficult.
: You are stronger than most, Magistrate. But your loyalty will not go unnoticed by those who are viewing these events from the safety of their own bedrooms right now.
: Do you think they got an option to view a route where I did wind up cheating on my husband?
: I imagine they did, yes. Married woman make exceptional targets for those looking to virtually power trip.
: How do you think that route is compared to the one I chose?
: Speaking from experience, much better.
scene baristawar28
: Aww man...really?
: I truly do believe that the Supreme Overlord’s penis has been blessed by one of the old gods. But that could just be any penis. I don’t know. I’ve only ever had one inside of me. But it was great.
: Yeah, I’m sure it was...
: Don’t be too sure, though. Someone will call it NTR and say thought-crimes are still crimes.
: Molly, I hope you know that if either of the two girls up there are good at this, I’m hiring one of them to replace you.
: Please don’t. This is where I get my gacha money.
scene baristawar29
: Okay, okay! I can only make one at a time, people! JUST ONE. PLEASE WAIT.

: First off, if you’re only making one drink at a time in a fast paced environment like this, you’re never going to last. Second, we’re not really supposed to yell at customers no matter how badly we may want to.
scene baristawar30
: Why not? It’s not like these ones can understand what I’m saying.
: No, but they can understand your tone. And someone in the store might also take offense to seeing how you treat them and think about taking their business somewhere else.
: The fuck are you even helping me for? Shouldn’t you be giving Sana advice or something since she’s actually on your team?
: I’m mostly just hanging around to make sure you don’t break anything. And Sana’s doing fine, so I don’t really need to help her anyway.
: One...caramel...frozen copyrighted beverage. Okay.
scene baristawar31
: Could you tell me what type of sugar you use for that? And also what type of milk?
: Sugar, yes. This drink is sugar.
: Still a bit of a language barrier, though.
scene baristawar32
: How...pay?
: I’ll use my credit card.
: Huh?
: Uhh...creditto? Kudasai?
: I’m sorry. I don’t understand.
: Still sure she doesn’t need any help?
: She’ll figure it out. We all have to.
scene baristawar33
: C...Card! Credit card!
: Rin, please help break her out of that Gen Z stare thing you girls are always doing now so the next person can order.
: カードで、小菜ちゃん。
scene baristawar34
: ああはい。わかりました。Please tap. Thank you business.
: When do I get a turn on the register? That seems way easier than trying to figure out how to work this espresso machine thing. I can’t even get this fucking handle off.
scene baristawar35
: That’s actually called a portafilter. It-
: Sana! Switch places with me!
: Okay, yeah. I’ll just go fuck myself.
scene baristawar36
: Okay. So, the first thing you’re going to want to do is-
: I...think I get it. We...have one of these at the bar. It’s just...much smaller.
: You have a steaming wand too? Or is it one of those smaller ones with a frother instead, like we have in the dorm?
: I...uhh...is there a difference?
: Yeah, I’ll show you. With steaming wands, you-
: Order please. You speak.
: O...Osu...sumay wa...na...nani...desu ka?
ki" おすすめ？Coffee."
: Regular coffee?
: Regular coffee.
: Okay...
: I’ll have an upside down, non-fat, whole milk, extra hot iced chai with nine pumps of raspberry, two packets of this sugar I brought from home, chocolate whipped cream, and a caramel drizzle.

: But if you could do the crosshatch pattern on top of the whipped cream like you’d do with a caramel macchiato in addition to the drizzle inside of the cup, that would be great. Also, I have a coupon.
: Want me to spit in it too?
: Please don’t spit in his drink, Kirin. It’s bad enough as is.
: Um...on...onegaishimasu?
scene baristawar37
: I don’t know. Sounds like he wants me to spit in it.
: They just say お願いします or 大丈夫です to basically every single question during checkout and hope for the best. I don’t think he actually wants you to spit in the drink.
: Please...spit in my drink.
scene baristawar38
: Oh...or he’s one of those.
: はい！かしこまりました！お支払方法はどうされますか？カードで？現金？君わかりますか？
: Uhh...onegaishimasu?
scene baristawar39
: Give me your fucking credit card or I will grind you into dust and put you inside the fucking portafilter.
: Dude, I think she likes you.
: Right? It totally feels that way.
scene baristawar40
: Okay! So Kirin is fired. And Koi Cafe does not endorse or support the unfair treatment of foreigners, including but not limited to insulting and/or pouring hot beverages on them.
: It was iced.
: I think technically he...said iced and...extra hot, so...I’m not really sure what that makes the drink...
: Which is a totally reasonable thing to think! But here at Koi Cafe, the customer is always right. Even when they’re wrong. So sometimes, you just need to let them think they’re doing a good job.
scene baristawar41
: That said, it goes without question that the winner here today is Sana. And that she’s welcome to actually work here whenever she wants since that really wasn’t all that bad for a first time.
: I...appreciate that...but I don’t think my mom would like the idea of you...poaching me from the bar very much...
: That’s fine. She can have Kirin. You guys already have Yuki and people apparently love it when she’s mean to them over there.
: I may have lost, but today was surprisingly therapeutic. I’m not opposed to doing it again.
: I will...relay the message...
scene baristawar42
: Well, thankfully, you won’t need to wait very long to do that! Because the tenth and final contest of this year’s Dorm Wars will once again be taking place at Sakaki-bar-a!
: But before you go, remember to shop at Koi Cafe! Where we’ll spit in any drink so long as you pay us enough!
: Wait, I never signed up for that!
